metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.9 · 2022 · The Bad Guys
metas.description: To avoid prison, a gang of notorious animal criminals pretends to seek being rehabilitated, only for their leader to realize that he genuinely wants to change his ways.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Bad Guys 2
metas.description: The Bad Guys are struggling to find trust and acceptance in their newly minted lives as Good Guys, when they are pulled out of retirement and forced to do "one last job" by an all-female squad of criminals.
